prompt:
ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down at the object's TOP SURFACE ONLY. Rectangular edges run horizontally and vertically on the canvas. Show no vertical front or side faces.

Create an ORIGINAL game sprite part for the D'thorga drill rig: a rack of water-well liner pipes that bolts onto its deck. Image 1 is our approved drill rig body: match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only, and use it to see where this part sits. Do NOT redraw the drill rig.

Draw ONLY this part, alone on a plain pure white background: nothing else on the canvas. Tall canvas. Five long straight pale grey plumbing pipes for lining a water well, lying side by side, their long axes from top to bottom, each with a threaded coupling collar at its top end, held by two dark steel clamp straps across them on a low steel rack; the bundle fills about 85 percent of the canvas height, centred.

Style: a top-down sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, pale panels, rounded corners, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No truck, cab, wheels, deck, cargo, people, animals, smoke, dust, mud, damage, text, letters, numbers, logos, symbols, dials or screens. No floor, ground, shadow outside the part, perspective, tilt or visible side faces. Top surfaces only.
